bull_argument.argument:
Netflix reported revenue growth of 13% and profit growth around 9%, supporting continued expansion despite disappointing next-quarter expectations. A 24.34x trailing multiple and positive cash conversion create a credible conditional quality-growth proposition.

Content economics and the guidance slowdown must be incorporated rather than dismissed. The bounce has not repaired the full trend, so patient accumulation after operating and price stabilization is the strongest bullish implementation rather than buying solely because of the drawdown. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
24.34x quoted earnings conflicts with 29.35x market-cap/profit, while weaker next-quarter expectations temper growth. Content economics and competition matter even with strong current margins.

The bounce holds above SMA50 but remains below SMA20 and SMA200 with bearish momentum; a short recovery has not repaired the broader structure. The price evidence does not independently establish an attractive immediate allocation. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.
